body: Founder #1: 'battlegrounds for dragonsnshit is redgarden' -- corrected REDGARDEN_GUI_NORTHSTAR.md's original thesis (REDGARDEN as rendering-only skin) to: REDGARDEN's full real-time combat framework becomes DragonsNShit's Battlegrounds, an instanced PvP mode. Founder #2, immediately after: 'not the same literal game loop maybe but we want our old systems like skillchains etc work with redgarden affordances' -- refined further: process/loop stays separate (Battlegrounds still its own spawned-per-match process) but ability content cast through REDGARDEN's Q/W/R slots is apps2/mud's real job/weapon-skill/skillchain system ported into arena_game.c's slot machinery. Pick a job not a fixed hero; real skillchain resonance between players' casts, rendered through REDGARDEN's own vocabulary. Both corrections labeled and dated in place. Milestone table rewritten: port Warrior's real kit first, then skillchain resonance, then entry-point/reward-credit hooks. Commit c83b40b.
title: REDGARDEN Battlegrounds design corrected twice in real time
